digest.component_or_area: Git version floor enforcement and merge-tree regression test
propositions: The two-clone enrichment regression test for bug 8185 requires git merge-tree --write-tree, available only in Git 2.38 and newer, but the repository did not declare or enforce this version floor.
Git 2.38+ floor must be declared as a single source of truth and enforced consistently across contributor documentation, CI workflows, and test execution, rather than guarded with skip machinery.
The merge-tree regression must fail immediately and clearly during pytest session startup if the Git version floor is violated, preventing silent test vacuity on under-floor clients.

The Git version floor is enforced in pytest_configure via tests/_git_floor.floor_violation(), declared in .github/git-version-floor.txt, gated in the CI workflow before test execution, and documented in README, CONTRIBUTING, and local-dev-env.md.
Test suites must detect and fail if merge-tree regressions are guarded by skip machinery or if no regressions using merge-tree exist, preventing guard vacuity rot.
